old_caption: The video captures a serene mountain landscape featuring a tranquil lake in the foreground. The lake's surface is calm, reflecting the surrounding trees and the majestic mountain peak in the background. The trees, primarily coniferous, stand tall along the shoreline, their green foliage contrasting with the blue tones of the sky and water. The mountain, partially covered in snow, rises prominently in the distance, its rugged peaks shrouded in mist. The lighting suggests either early morning or late afternoon, casting a soft glow over the scene. There are no visible animals or characters in the video; it focuses entirely on the natural beauty of the environment. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to take in the peaceful and picturesque setting.

caption: The video captures a serene alpine scene in which a snow-streaked mountain peak rises behind a horizontal band of coniferous trees lining a calm lake. The lower half of the frame mirrors the dark tree silhouettes and pale sky, and these reflections show slight shimmer as fine ripples disturb the water. The framing remains largely steady, with the peak apex, tree line, and shoreline staying in place. On the left edge a soft sun glare with a faint hexagonal flare circle glows at roughly constant position and intensity. Thin mist clings to the mountain's right shoulder, drifting and reshaping very slowly. The tree trunks and canopies show no obvious sway, and the snow patches appear unchanged.

draft_caption: The video captures a serene alpine scene in which a snow-streaked mountain peak rises behind a horizontal band of coniferous trees lining a calm lake. The lower half of the frame mirrors the dark tree silhouettes and pale sky, and these reflections shimmer and wobble continuously as gentle ripples travel across the water. The framing holds steady, with the peak apex, tree line, and shoreline fixed in place throughout. On the left edge a soft sun glare with a faint hexagonal flare circle glows at roughly constant position and intensity. Thin mist clings to the mountain's right shoulder and summit, drifting and reshaping very slowly over the clip. The tree trunks and canopies show no discernible sway, and the snow patches remain static. A small watermark logo sits fixed in the bottom-left corner as the lake's quiet rippling persists.
